==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will only cast this spell on primary casters, prioritizing healers and targets with adjacent 'bonus' targets.

==Notes==
* The caster gains energy from ''each'' foe affected by the hex.
* No energy gain happens when the hex is renewed.
{{anomaly| Unlike other [[Skill quick reference#Hexes that affect the caster|hexes that affect the caster]], this one doesn't end if the caster [[Death|dies]].}}
